name: Gif Bot
tagline: Turn a described YouTube moment into a captioned, soundless GIF for chat
description: Describe a YouTube moment and it finds that exact stretch, burns the spoken lines onto the frames as captions, and exports a muted clip sized for phones. You get GIF and MP4 versions that drop straight into a group chat. Nothing is posted anywhere; the files are yours to share.
author: dklein09
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
